svg.aria-label: Operator profile: Nitya Prakash Pandey, BS Data Science at IIT Madras, vision and ML engineer. BS Data Science student at IIT Madras who likes taking ML from a notebook to a working system. Most of my time goes into medical imaging: at SGBC Brain Centre I integrate and benchmark brain-segmentation tools and score them with Dice. The rest goes into hackathons and Kaggle, where I build vision and agentic systems against tight deadlines. Active missions: Brain MRI segmentation benchmarks (SGBC Brain Centre · SynthSeg · BiomedParse · ANTsPy); Reddit credibility & network research (Research internship · DoMS); Chandrayaan-2 lunar image registration (Smart India Hackathon 2026); Kaggle & hackathons (Agriculture · health · climate). Also built: Travel RAG agent · LangGraph · Qdrant · Cohere; Whole-slide pathology pipeline · PyTorch foundation models; AgroSkin · AI skin-disease detector; FieldPilot AI · 10-agent smart-glasses inspector; TyreMind · physics-informed race ML; SAGE · agentic commerce control plane
